soldier: Head yellowish brown, pronotum yellow, abdomen pale yellow. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.66, lateral margins almost parallel and slightly extending posteriorly, posterior margin broadly rounded. Frontal peaks very weakly raised, shallowly concave between them. Labrum lanceolate, length and width nearly equal, apical and subapical setae present, lateral apical setae absent. Mandibles stout and short, left mandible about 0.83–0.86 times head width and about 0.55–0.57 times head capsule length, apex slightly curved, the basal ridge on the outer margin discernible. Antennae 16 segments. Waist constriction index of the postmentum 0.38–0.43; head width about 7 times the waist constriction, postmentum about 6–7 times the waist constriction. Pronotum about 1.6–1.7 times as wide as long, the incision at the anterior margin deeper than at the posterior margin, lateral margins steeply sloping posteriorly; 20 long setae or thereabouts in the middle region.
taxonomy_note: The letters of the genus name are defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; this is in fact Reticulitermes, the same genus name as used on this site.
